company.name: Zone
company.shortDescription: Zone is a Web3 platform that combines competitive gaming, esports, fantasy sports & blockchain-powered rewards.
company.description: Zone is a decentralized GameFi and esports platform designed to bring blockchain technology into mainstream gaming experiences. Built across multiple blockchain networks including Algorand and BNB Chain, the platform offers a wide variety of gaming experiences such as hypercasual games, fantasy sports, PvP competitions, esports tournaments, and reward-based gaming challenges. The platform focuses on player engagement through competitive gameplay, digital rewards, NFT integrations, and crypto-enabled marketplaces. Zone has hosted large-scale Web3 gaming tournaments and fan engagement campaigns, attracting hundreds of thousands of gamers globally. Its ecosystem also includes crypto gift card marketplaces, gaming leagues, and sports-focused activations that bridge traditional entertainment with blockchain-based incentives.

productsAndServices.description: A blockchain-based platform on Algorand enabling users to play games, earn cryptocurrencies (ALGO, ZONE), and trade NFTs.
productsAndServices.name: Zone GameFi Platform
